artworks.title: A Newhaven Pilot's Cottage Door
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows a group of six people, five women and one man, posing in front of a textured wall. All individuals are displayed from head to toe. The man, second from the left, is standing with his arms crossed, wearing a dark suit, a top hat, and glasses. The women are dressed in simple, period-appropriate clothing with long skirts and blouses. Most have their hair covered with cloths or headscarves. The central seated woman has her chin resting on her hand, while another seated on the right seems to be holding something. The standing women have their arms on their hips or crossed. The setting seems to be outdoors, indicated by the dirt ground and the rough-textured wall behind them with a shadow cast upon it, suggesting bright lighting conditions.

artworks.title: Beech Tree, Forest of Fontainebleau
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a view of a tree trunk with many leaves. The tree trunk is in the center of the photograph, reaching upwards and partly covered by the leaves. The background is blurred, but other trees can be seen in the distance. The ground is covered in short grass.

artworks.title: Oak Tree
artworks.description: This faded, sepia-toned photograph shows a leafless tree in front of a light gray sky. The tree's branches form a dark silhouette against the background. There are other bare trees on the low horizon line, sprouting from light gray ground.

artworks.title: Piwyac, Vernal Fall, 300 feet, Yosemite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and David Robinson

artworks.title: Cape Horn, Columbia River, Oregon
artworks.description: The image shows a calm body of water with a curved shoreline and towering cliffs on the left. Small trees cling to the cliff tops. The horizon is marked by distant hills on the right. The color palette is warm sepia. Rocks in the water are reflected on its surface. In the distance, a forest of trees stretches towards the sky.

artworks.title: Sugar Loaf Island, Farallons
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky island viewed from an elevated point, displaying its rugged surface. The horizon is visible in the upper part of the image, leading into a foggy sky. The picture lacks visible brushstrokes, suggesting it is a photograph. The color scheme is predominantly earthy, with brown and beige tones. Sea lions populate the island's rocks, and the surrounding water appears misty. In the background, the ocean extends toward the hazy horizon, contrasting with the detailed rocks and wildlife.

artworks.title: The Happy Family with Children Playing
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and gray washes over graphite on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and The Herbert and Nannette Rothschild Memorial Fund in memory of Judith Rothschild
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in historical attire within an interior setting. A woman is holding a child, another girl is seated nearby, and a man stands to the left. Another woman looks at the children. Additional children and a small dog are also present, along with various decorative elements in the background.

artworks.title: Old Vennel, Off High Street
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a narrow, cobblestone street flanked by aged stone buildings. The photograph captures an alleyway with stone walls. Suspended above the street are hanging cloths on lines strung between the buildings. The buildings have small, rectangular windows, and one features a wooden sign. An overcast sky adds an element of atmosphere to the scene. The perspective draws the eye down the alley. Shadows and highlights hint at diffused light.

artworks.title: Nether Hall
artworks.medium: waxed-paper negative with brown and black ink
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a landscape with a prominent architectural structure resembling a castle or tower on the left side of the frame. There is a smaller, traditional house with a gabled roof on the right side, slightly in the distance. The picture has the style of a photographic negative with a monochromatic sepia color palette. The sky is dark sepia, and the buildings and trees are in lighter tones, giving the scene an aged appearance. Details like tree branches, brick, and stone textures are visible, softened by the inverse coloring.

artworks.title: View of the Louvre
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an architectural structure. The image shows a building with classical design elements such as arched windows, columns, statues, and sculptures on the rooftop. There is scaffolding at the top of the building. The facade is detailed with reliefs and carvings. The setting includes a garden area with bare trees in the foreground. The lighting indicates that the photograph was taken during the daytime, casting long shadows on the building.

artworks.title: Bibliothèque Imperiale du Louvre
artworks.description: This image shows an ornate and classical architectural facade. It features a grand classical building with intricate detailing, grand columns, a large arched entranceway framed by textured columns, a richly detailed frieze, and statues of robed figures between arched windows. The facade is adorned with ornate sculptures and relief work, including a pediment with carved figures. At street level, a horse-drawn cart is visible.

artworks.title: Gare de Longueau
artworks.description: The image shows a railway station with tracks leading toward it. The station has large arched windows and circular elements in the architecture. A smaller building is visible to the side, nestled against a sloping escarpment. Trees and foliage are present along the left side, while the overall color scheme is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Church of Saint-Pierre, Caen
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a Gothic-style cathedral spire. The spire dominates the image, showcasing Gothic architectural elements such as pointed arches, stone carvings, and pinnacles. The spire is adorned with decorative elements like quatrefoil and clover shapes. The base of the spire has intricate stonework, while the upper part ends in a needle-like point. Surrounding the spire are elements of the cathedral, including stone balustrades and additional pinnacles.

artworks.title: Niagara
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned view of a large waterfall cascading over a rocky cliff. The horizon is visible at the top with buildings, including one with a flag, silhouetted against the sky. The flowing water appears smooth and misty due to a long exposure, descending from the top of the falls to the river below. Rocks disrupt the water's flow, creating white splashes. The image has a soft, blurred quality due to motion in the water. The color palette is muted and vintage, emphasizing textures and contrasts rather than distinct colors. In the distance, dense trees flank the structures.

artworks.title: Battlefield in Atlanta
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with railway tracks in the foreground. Beyond the tracks is an area of rough terrain with sparse shrubbery leading to a gently sloping hill in the background. Scattered trees and hints of vegetation are visible, with a man-made structure or fortifications on the horizon. The color tones are predominantly brown and beige, with a pale sky.

artworks.title: Queen Adelaide's Beech
artworks.artist: Earl of Caithness and William Bambridge
artworks.description: The image shows a ground level view looking up through a grove of leafless trees that dominate the scene. The horizon is low due to being obscured by the trunks and branches of the trees. Two figures are visible near the base of a tall tree, suggesting a small clearing. The color palette is monochromatic with variations of sepia tones. Close to the viewer, the earthy tones of the ground cover and tree trunks create texture, while the intricate web of branches stretches towards the sky above and is silhouetted against the light background, providing contrast in the image.

artworks.title: The Oxford Arms, Warwick Lane
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 23.8 x 18.2 cm (9 3/8 x 7 3/16 in.)
support: 45.9 x 35.6 cm (18 1/16 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow cobblestone alleyway between old buildings. A person is seen in the distance standing under a passageway leading further into the alley or another open space. On either side of the passage, there are structures with distinct architectural features, including brick and wood. To the left, there is a stone or brick building, while the right side has a wooden facade. Signs are visible, advertising businesses such as "CHARINGTON'S HEAD & CO." and "NELSON & CO. PRINTING OFFICES," with words like "ALES" and "The OXFORD ARMS" indicating a local establishment. The photograph has a moody and atmospheric feel, emphasized by the textures of the buildings and the diffused lighting filtering through the misty distance, casting soft shadows and highlights. The scene conveys a sense of a bygone era, capturing the character and ambiance of urban life at that time.

artworks.title: Mary Hillier and Two Children
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, all of whom are partially visible from the shoulders up. The central figure is positioned slightly behind the two other individuals, who are leaning forward with their heads resting on their arms. The central person's facial features are softly focused, with a neutral expression, and they have a cloth covering their head. The two individuals in the front have long, wavy hair and their expressions are somewhat indistinct. They are each resting their head on one arm. The attire appears soft with textures suggesting loose and plain fabric. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is blurred and dark.

artworks.title: Deathbed Study of Adeline Grace Clogstoun
artworks.description: This black-and-white photograph shows a young girl lying on a bed. She is lying with her head on a pillow on the right, her feet at the other end of the bed on the left. Her eyes are closed, and she has pale skin and curly hair. She is wearing a light-colored garment, and her hands are crossed on her chest. There seem to be some white flowers near her hands. The room is dimly lit with dark draped fabric behind her on the other side of the bed. In the background, there is patterned wallpaper and a framed picture hanging on the wall on the far right. Light is coming in through a partially obscured window.

artworks.title: Salerne
artworks.description: The image shows a vintage photograph taken from a low angle. In the background, there are hills with small structures scattered around. Two large boats are the main focus, resting on barrels. The boats are covered with cloths or tarps. The color scheme is sepia, emphasizing a historical look. The sand, sky, dust, and texture add to the aged atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: View of Rome
artworks.description: The image shows a river winding through cultivated fields with a small boat anchored nearby. In the distance, there is a cityscape with various buildings, including a prominent domed structure to the right. The photo has a soft, sepia-tone palette, giving it an aged feel.

artworks.title: Carrefour de l'Epine
artworks.description: The image displays a dense forest with tall, leafless trees and intricate networks of bare branches. The horizon is obscured by the thick cluster of trees, dominating the scene from closest to us to the far distance. The ground is covered with bushes and undergrowth, adding texture and depth. The photograph is in monochrome or sepia tone, giving it an antique quality. The atmosphere is muted with subtle contrasts between the light sky and the dark, silhouetted trees, evoking a calm woodland scene.

artworks.title: Parc de Courances
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow river running through a forested landscape. Trees and dense foliage fill the upper portion of the view, with tree trunks and branches extending to the edges. The style is photographic, capturing details of the trees and their reflections in the water. The color palette is monochromatic and sepia-toned, highlighting textures of the bark and branches. Deep shadows of tree trunks dominate the left side, while the river leads towards a lighter area in the distance, possibly where it merges with brighter light or an opening in the trees.

artworks.title: Belle Croix
artworks.description: The image displays a natural scene with a small body of water reflecting the landscape. Leafless trees, rocks scattered around, and a serene horizon are visible. The composition is balanced, with trees on the left and in the distance on the right. The color palette is muted and sepia-toned, giving the image an aged quality. Details are precise, showing textures clearly.
